observable_pass_condition: Proposing an allowlisted goal produces persisted proposed revision without worker jobs
Unknown tool or executable command is rejected without side effects
Owner explicitly approves the displayed exact immutable revision only
Stale or altered revision/hash approval is denied; no job dispatched
Two simultaneous approvals result in exactly one decision and one first job
Approval response timeout leads to GET reconciliation, not blind retry
Rejected revision cannot be approved, resumed or dispatched later
Unapproved proposal modification creates linked successor with clear before/after diff
Prior superseded revision cannot later be approved
Approved but undispatched edit invalidates future dispatch pending new approval
In-flight edit stops future claims but does not falsely declare running handler stopped
Running goal stays primary when another proposal awaits owner approval
Pending actions appear beside task context and do not mask progress or receipt link
Task detail shows actor/action/target/scope/impact on consequential approval
Narrow viewport, delayed send, reconnect and switch-session do not attach wrong decision
Pause blocks new claims but correctly reports existing work may continue
Resume rechecks revision, actor grant, provider, model, expiry and budget
Cancel removes pending work; reported state distinguishes in-flight uncertainty
Interrupted running job enters attention; it is not silently replayed
Ambiguous consequential result requires reconciliation before another attempt
Expired/revoked/endpoint-changed model consent fails at actual call boundary
Consumed model call remains counted after disconnect, crash or revocation
Unknown price or zero paid-call budget does not initiate paid provider request
Worker reported completion is not independently verified by default
Verifier uses exact goal revision, job, evidence and source SHA; unrelated CI rejected
Stale, missing, failed or mocked evidence cannot yield verified success
Result, events, revision links and denial state survive reload and service restart
No extra permissions, cloud writer, remote API exposure, private data leak or model-generated code execution
